This name is perfect for a little one who is gentle, soft, and nurturing, and who will bring peace and comfort to those around her. The name Ranaa carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ranaa usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
